title: Centre in 90 seconds
summary: The quickest version of the first move. Use it when the pressure is already up.

steps.heading: Centre in 90 seconds
body: For the moment when you are already in it: the meeting is going badly, the message has landed, the child is shouting.
3 moves, 90 seconds, nothing anyone else will notice.

steps.heading: Feet, breath, glance
steps.intro: Do them in this order. Turn the shape or press Next.

points.label: Feet
points.body: Both feet flat on the floor. Press down a little. Notice the floor is holding you up.

points.label: Breath
points.body: Breathe in normally. Breathe out slowly, longer than the in breath. Twice.

points.label: Glance
points.body: Look away from the screen or the person, to something that is not asking anything of you. A window, a wall, the ceiling. Then come back.

steps.heading: Right now
steps.prompt: Do the 3 moves now, wherever you are. Then write 1 line about what changed, even if it was small.
steps.placeholder: For example: my breathing is slower and the message does not look as urgent.

steps.heading: Keep it
points: It works better with practice, so use it on small moments too.
The full lesson on Centre is in The Executive Frame Reset.
